summary: Preserved the existing normalized-email/Argon2id Admin login and shared rotating-session model, and implemented a protected internal first-Super-Admin bootstrap. The bootstrap uses strict shared contracts, an explicit confirmation, an Argon2id credential, an immutable unique guard, and a MongoDB transaction that atomically creates the verified Admin identity, profile, credential, and bootstrap record. It refuses existing or concurrent bootstrap attempts, exposes no HTTP bootstrap route, and does not introduce credentials or production data.
